package com.my_app.events.sub-domain.order_line;

import java.util.LinkedHashMap;
import java.util.Map;

public record OrderLineItemAddedData(
    String 1,
    String 2,
    String 10,
    String 4294967294,
    String snake_case_name,
    String kebab-case-name,
    String camelCaseName,
    String PascalCaseName,
    Integer HTTPStatusCode,
    String 9lives,
    String class,
    Integer int,
    Boolean public,
    String def,
    String import,
    String new,
    String return,
    String function,
    String None,
    String with space,
    String dotted.name,
    String Anything,
    String ,
    String b,
    String 01,
    String a,
    String 4294967295
) {

    @SuppressWarnings("unchecked")
    public static OrderLineItemAddedData fromMap(Map<String, Object> map) {
        return new OrderLineItemAddedData(
            (String) map.get("1"),
            (String) map.get("2"),
            (String) map.get("10"),
            (String) map.get("4294967294"),
            (String) map.get("snake_case_name"),
            (String) map.get("kebab-case-name"),
            (String) map.get("camelCaseName"),
            (String) map.get("PascalCaseName"),
            (Integer) map.get("HTTPStatusCode"),
            (String) map.get("9lives"),
            (String) map.get("class"),
            (Integer) map.get("int"),
            (Boolean) map.get("public"),
            (String) map.get("def"),
            (String) map.get("import"),
            (String) map.get("new"),
            (String) map.get("return"),
            (String) map.get("function"),
            (String) map.get("None"),
            (String) map.get("with space"),
            (String) map.get("dotted.name"),
            (String) map.get("Anything"),
            (String) map.get(""),
            (String) map.get("b"),
            (String) map.get("01"),
            (String) map.get("a"),
            (String) map.get("4294967295")
        );
    }

    public Map<String, Object> toMap() {
        var map = new LinkedHashMap<String, Object>();
        map.put("1", 1);
        map.put("2", 2);
        map.put("10", 10);
        map.put("4294967294", 4294967294);
        map.put("snake_case_name", snake_case_name);
        map.put("kebab-case-name", kebab-case-name);
        map.put("camelCaseName", camelCaseName);
        map.put("PascalCaseName", PascalCaseName);
        map.put("HTTPStatusCode", HTTPStatusCode);
        map.put("9lives", 9lives);
        map.put("class", class);
        map.put("int", int);
        map.put("public", public);
        map.put("def", def);
        map.put("import", import);
        map.put("new", new);
        map.put("return", return);
        map.put("function", function);
        map.put("None", None);
        map.put("with space", with space);
        map.put("dotted.name", dotted.name);
        map.put("Anything", Anything);
        map.put("", );
        map.put("b", b);
        map.put("01", 01);
        map.put("a", a);
        map.put("4294967295", 4294967295);
